Anya: Heads-up — opened a tiny PR to unify streaming snippets across py/ts/go and add a short retry helper. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4410

docs-bot: PR 4410 opened by Anya — title: 'docs: consolidate streaming examples + add retry util'

Rafi: Quick skim — liking the consolidation. TS example still uses event callbacks; we should prefer async iterators (for-await-of) for clarity.

Priya: Agreed. Also the Python snippet uses bare excepts; let's show a concise backoff helper (exponential + cap + jitter). Keep it compact (6-10 lines).

Anya: Draft checklist: 1) TS -> for-await 2) Py -> async generator + backoff util 3) Go -> channel + context pattern 4) small note about cursor TTL and migration from header -> body 5) fix old link on streaming overview page

Rafi: Proposed TS patch:```ts
async function streamExample() {
  const stream = client.asyncGenerate({ prompt: 'Hello' })
  for await (const part of stream) {
    process.stdout.write(part.text)
  }
}
```

Priya: Py backoff (tiny):```python
async def with_backoff(gen, *a, **kw):
    for i in range(4):
        try:
            async for x in gen(*a, **kw):
                yield x
            return
        except TransientError:
            await asyncio.sleep(min(1 * 2**i, 8) + random.random())
```

Rafi: Go snippet (channel + ctx):```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 45*time.Second)
defer cancel()
ch := make(chan string)
go func(){ defer close(ch); for c := range client.AsyncGenerate(ctx, prompt){ ch<-c.Text }}()
for s := range ch { fmt.Print(s) }
```

Anya: Nice. For the pagination migration note: new runtime returns next_cursor in JSON body (resp.next_cursor) instead of X-Next-Cursor header. Add one-liner in each language showing how to read it.

Priya: I'll add the Python line: `cursor = resp.get('next_cursor')` and a one-liner comment.

Rafi: I'll update TS/Go snippets accordingly. Also pushing a tiny redirect in streaming overview to the new path.

Anya: Can everyone push to branch by EOD so I can merge tomorrow? I'll also run the docs preview to verify sample rendering. Ping here when pushed.

Priya: Done — pushed Python helper + note.

Rafi: TS+Go pushed, updated streaming overview link.
